jobs.description:
Clevertronic ist der Rundum-Partner fürs Smartphone-Leben: Wir kaufen gebrauchte Smartphones, Tablets und weitere Elektronik an, bereiten sie professionell auf und geben ihnen als geprüfte Refurbished-Produkte ein zweites Leben.

Mit rund 100 Kolleg:innen, mehr als 50 Mio. Euro Umsatz und profitablem Wachstum ohne Investoren gehören wir zu den größten Refurbishing-Unternehmen Deutschlands. Jetzt entwickeln wir Clevertronic zu einer Plattform rund ums Smartphone-Leben weiter - mit neuen Produkten, Geschäftsmodellen und Märkten.

Dafür suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die direkt mit unserer Geschäftsführung zusammenarbeitet, eigene Themen vorantreibt und aus Ideen messbare Ergebnisse macht.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für E-Commerce-Produkte und strategische Projekte: von der ersten Analyse bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
  • Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du neue Produkte, Geschäftsfelder und Wachstumsinitiativen.
  • Du steuerst deine Themen anhand messbarer Ergebnisse wie Umsatz, Conversion und Kundenzufriedenheit.
  • Du begleitest Projekte nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern packst auch im Tagesgeschäft mit an und lernst unsere Prozesse von Grund auf kennen.
  • Du setzt KI gezielt ein, um Analysen, Prozesse und die Zusammenarbeit im Unternehmen schneller und besser zu machen.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst relevante Praxiserfahrung im E-Commerce mit und verstehst die Mechanismen von Onlineshops und digitalen Customer Journeys.
  • Du hast bereits ein Produkt, Projekt, Geschäftsfeld oder eigenes Business von Grund auf aufgebaut und erfolgreich vorangetrieben.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Fachbereiche zusammenbringen und aus einer Idee einen umsetzbaren Plan entwickeln.
  • Du interessierst dich für KI und nutzt sie bereits als praktisches Werkzeug in deinem Arbeitsalltag.
  • Du hast Lust, dich intensiv mit unseren operativen Prozessen auseinanderzusetzen und auch bei den Details mit anzupacken.
  • Du hast große Ambitionen und willst in den nächsten Jahren außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung übernehmen - zunächst für eigene Projekte, perspektivisch für ein eigenes Team und einen eigenen Geschäftsbereich.

Benefits

  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung: Du sitzt bei Strategie, Zahlen und Entscheidungen mit am Tisch - mit eigener Stimme, nicht als Zuhörer. Was du dabei über die Führung eines Unternehmens dieser Größe mitnimmst, ist der Nebeneffekt.

jobs.description:
Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role

We're hiring the first dedicated owner of Omnea's performance marketing.

You're not starting from scratch. Paid campaigns, the website and our social channels all exist (and are working to varying degrees). But nobody's job is to work out what actually produces pipeline and then make more of it. That's this role: take what's already running, find the ROI, and professionalise it into something we can be proud of.

In one week you might work out why a paid campaign is generating leads that never convert, rebuild the landing page that's losing them, build a new LinkedIn audience off the back of our closed-won data, and show the exec team what the pipeline picture looks like.

If you want to run one channel and hand-off the numbers, this might not be for you. If you want to own the loop from spend through to pipeline, and have the data to prove what worked, it is.

You'll work closely with our digital agency partners, the field marketers running events in the UK and US, and the sales team who rely on the pipeline you generate.

What you'll own

Pipeline and performance

You'll build the picture of what marketing is actually returning, and you'll be the person with the answer when someone asks whether a channel is worth the money.

  • Own the pipeline number for our digital channels: how much, from where, and at what cost

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Dreamdata using sources like HubSpot and GA4

  • Track campaigns from first touch through to closed won, and use what you find to change what we run next

  • Run a proper testing cadence. Set the test, call the result, and stop the things that aren't working

  • Report on what the numbers mean, not only what they are

Paid

You own paid. Our agency handles campaign build and optimisation, and you set the direction they work to.

  • Act as day-to-day partner to the agency: set the brief, shape audience strategy and funnel design, and decide together what to test next and how to deploy 6-figure annual ad spend.

  • Own LinkedIn as our primary paid channel: audiences, target account lists, retargeting and sequencing

  • Build audiences from our own data: closed-won patterns, target accounts, product signals - rather than off-the-shelf targeting

  • Work with content and design teammates to produce compelling content

  • Make the case for more budget when the numbers justify it

Website and conversion

  • Own conversion across the site: forms, journeys, page structure, and what happens after someone clicks an ad

  • Build and update pages using our existing component library and CMS

  • Run an ongoing testing programme on the pages that matter, and work with the in-house design team on what comes next

  • Ship landing pages for campaigns and product launches, including forms and tracking

  • Keep tracking and attribution clean, so the reporting can be trusted

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a B2B marketing role, in-house or agency. We care more about what you delivered than where you did it.

  • You're commercial. You think in pipeline and cost per opportunity, not clicks and impressions, and you can tell the difference between a campaign that's busy and one that's working.

  • You know paid mechanics properly. Audiences, match rates, attribution windows, frequency. LinkedIn Ads specifically.

  • You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a report from scratch, spot when something looks wrong, and explain a trend to someone who wasn't in the weeds with you.

  • You've built pages in a CMS. Not from scratch in code — assembling pages from components, keeping them consistent, and getting the tracking right.

  • You've worked with or inside an agency, so you know how to write a brief and how to tell good work from work that's merely on time.

Nice to have

  • Comfortable in tools like HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, Campaign Manager

  • B2B SaaS, ideally selling to finance, procurement, legal or risk

  • SEO fundamentals

  • Enough Figma to work sensibly with designers

What good looks like in six months

  • We know what every pound of adspend returns, and everyone trusts the number

  • Paid is producing pipeline we can attribute, at a cost we're happy to scale

  • Our LinkedIn audiences are built from our own data rather than off-the-shelf targeting

  • The pages that carry the most traffic have been tested and improved

  • You're the person the exec team asks when they want to know whether a channel is working

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries — builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged

  • Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers

  • Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

  • Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn

  • A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.

  • Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement

  • Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. jobs.title: VP, Growth
jobs.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.

Join our Talent Pool

Not quite the right role, or the timing isn't right? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll be in touch when something fits: https://nivoda.net/talent-pool

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a motivated Working Student to join our team and support the development of autonomous quadruped robot applications.
You will work alongside experienced robotics engineers on R&D initiatives and customer projects. Depending on your skills, interests, and project needs, you will contribute to in one or more areas of quadruped robot software development, including perception, locomotion, autonomous behaviors, and robot applications.
This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with modern robotics software, simulation, and real robotic platforms while learning from experienced engineers in an international team.


Your Responsibilities

Depending on your skills and interests, you will contribute to one or more of the following areas:

  • Explore and prototype robotics algorithms and software solutions for autonomous quadruped robots.
  • Support the development and integration of robot applications, including perception, locomotion, navigation, and autonomous behaviors.
  • Work with sensors such as RGB cameras, depth cameras, LiDAR, and IMUs to evaluate and integrate robotics solutions for localization, mapping, motion planning, and environmental perception.
  • Test, validate, and optimize software performance in simulation and on physical robotic platforms.
  • Collaborate with the robotics team on R&D projects, customer demonstrations, and system integration.


Essential Skills

  • Strong Programming experience in Python and/or C++.
  • Familiarity with Linux development environments.
  • Understanding of robotics concepts, including kinematics, control, localization, mapping, and motion planning. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Beneficial Skills

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

  • ROS / ROS 2 and robotics software development
  • Computer vision and perception, such as OpenCV, object detection, point cloud processing, or 3D perception
  • Navigation and localization, including SLAM, state estimation, mapping, or motion planning
  • Robot control, such as feedback control, legged locomotion, Model Predictive Control (MPC), or Whole-Body Control
  • Machine learning or reinforcement learning for robotics applications
  • Robotics simulation, such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo
  • Mobile or legged robotics and autonomous robot applications
  • Git and collaborative software development


Your Profile

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Passionate about robotics and eager to learn new technologies.
  • Interested in developing expertise in robot applications, perception, or control systems.
  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Able to structure open-ended problems and communicate technical results clearly.
  • Careful and rigorous when testing, debugging, and documenting your work.
  • Available to work fully on-site, as the role involves hands-on work with physical robots.


What we offer

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge quadruped robotics.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced robotic platforms.
  • Mentorship from experienced robotics engineers.
  • Flexible working hours compatible with university studies.
  • A collaborative, innovative, and international work environment.

In this role, you will take ownership of a broad range of sophisticated commercial and technology-related legal matters across the Agile Robots Group. You will work closely with our Business, Engineering, Procurement and Management teams and advise on projects at the intersection of robotics, hardware, software and intellectual property.

We are looking for a lawyer with a strong foundation gained at a leading international law firm who enjoys taking direct ownership, working close to the business and finding pragmatic solutions in a fast-moving international environment.


Your Responsibilities

  • Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of complex national and international commercial agreements, including supply, procurement, sales, service, cooperation, development, licensing, software and technology agreements.
  • Independently lead sophisticated commercial legal matters from initial instruction through negotiation and execution, acting as the primary legal contact for the business.
  • Advise on intellectual property matters in a commercial context, in particular IP ownership, licensing, background and foreground IP, know-how and trade secrets, including the IP-related aspects of technology and development collaborations.

  • Act as a trusted legal business partner for internal stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and international group companies.
  • Provide legal support to group companies and recently acquired businesses within the group.
  • Proactively identify legal and commercial risks and develop pragmatic solutions that enable the business to achieve its objectives.

Your Profile

  • You are a fully qualified German lawyer (Volljurist) with strong academic credentials.
  • You have at least five years of post-qualification experience (i.e. after the Second State Examination), the majority of which was gained at a leading international law firm.
  • You have genuine, hands-on experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements and are comfortable independently leading negotiations with sophisticated counterparties.
  • You have strong exposure to intellectual property law in a commercial context, particularly IP licensing, technology-related agreements, know-how and trade-secret protection.
  • Experience advising technology, software, hardware, industrial or engineering businesses is a strong advantage.
  • In-house experience, whether through a previous in-house role or a substantial secondment, is highly desirable in addition to your law firm experience.
  • You have excellent drafting, negotiation and communication skills, take ownership and make pragmatic decisions without extensive internal processes or hierarchies.
  • You enjoy working as part of a small, collaborative team and are willing to support matters outside your immediate area of expertise when required.
  • You are fluent in German and English and comfortable negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in both languages.


What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

jobs.title: Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development
jobs.description:
About the role

The Industrial Application team of Agile Robots is looking for a motivated Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development to support the development, testing, and commissioning of industrial vision systems for robotic and AGV applications. In this full-time internship, you will work hands-on across the entire lifecycle of our vision solutions — from software development and camera calibration at our Munich headquarters to on-site commissioning at customer production sites.


Your Responsibilities

  • Vision Software Development: Develop, test, and maintain software components for industrial 2D/3D vision systems, including API-based secondary development on top of vision vendor SDKs.
  • Camera Setup & Calibration: Configure and calibrate 2D area-scan/line-scan cameras and 3D sensors for robotic and AGV applications, performing nine-point, checkerboard, and 3D hand-eye calibrations.
  • Algorithm Debugging: Support the debugging and tuning of core vision algorithms, from QR-code and natural-contour (V-SLAM) AGV navigation to deep-learning-based detection models.
  • Testing & Automation: Write Python scripts for automated testing and data-log analysis, and validate vision system performance in the lab and in production-like environments.
  • System Integration: Configure and troubleshoot data exchange between vision industrial PCs (IPCs) and PLCs, supporting communication via TCP/IP sockets, Modbus TCP, and ROS/ROS2.
  • On-Site Commissioning: Travel to customer sites to install, commission, fine-tune, and troubleshoot vision systems on real production lines.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to integrate vision solutions into end-to-end robotic systems.


Essential Skills

  • Education: Ongoing Bachelor's or Master's studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Automation, or a related field (or recently graduated).
  • Camera Hardware & Calibration: Hands-on experience configuring and calibrating mainstream 2D area-scan/line-scan cameras (e.g.Basler) and 3D sensors (e.g.Intel RealSense, structured-light cameras), including nine-point, checkerboard, and 3D hand-eye calibration.
  • Vision Algorithms: Understanding of the underlying logic of vision-based AGV navigation — QR-code navigation and natural-contour navigation (V-SLAM) — as well as the deployment of deep-learning-based detection models (e.g.the YOLO series).
  • Programming & Scripting: Good C++ and Python programming skills, with the ability to make API calls and perform simple secondary development based on vision vendor SDKs; proficient in Python for automated test scripts and data-log processing; comfortable working in Linux (Ubuntu) environments.
  • Industrial Communication: Ability to configure data exchange between vision IPCs and PLCs; understanding of TCP/IP socket communication, Modbus TCP, and ROS/ROS2 inter-node communication.
  • Learning Mindset: High motivation and curiosity to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and industrial vision applications.
  • Willingness to Travel: Willingness to travel to customer sites (domestic and international) for on-site commissioning activities.
  • Communication: Good communication skills in English/German and the ability to work hands-on in an international team.


Beneficial Skills

  • Commissioning Experience: First hands-on experience with on-site commissioning, installation, or servicing of vision systems, AGVs, robots, or other industrial automation equipment.
  • Vision Libraries: Familiarity with open-source frameworks such as OpenCV or PCL (Point Cloud Library).
  • Fieldbus Protocols: Exposure to further industrial communication standards such as PROFINET or EtherCAT.
  • Development Tools: Experience with Git, CMake, or Docker.
  • Languages: Chinese language skills are a plus.


What we offer

  • Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art robotics and vision technology in a dynamic, financially sound high-tech company
  • An interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ nationalities and a collaborative working environment
  • Close mentoring by experienced vision and robotics engineers, with real responsibility from day one
  • Unique insights into the full product lifecycle — from software development to deployment at customer sites
  • A modern office in Munich with free drinks and fruit, and regular company events
  • The opportunity to grow with us, with the prospect of a working student position or permanent role after your internship

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Overview

Develop and Maintain Transformation best practices in ELT Pipelines: Design, develop, and maintain efficient and scalable workflows using tools like dbt to transform raw data loaded into our data warehouse (Snowflake) into clean, ready-to-use data models.

Collaboration: Work closely with Data Analysts and business users to understand their reporting needs and optimise data models to support their analytical use cases. Collaborate with Data Engineers on data ingestion strategies and platform optimisation.

Performance Optimisation: Tune and optimise SQL queries and data models to reduce latency and improve the performance of our data warehouse and downstream applications.

Tool Adoption: Champion the adoption of modern data stack tools and practices (e.g. Git, CI/CD).

  • Experience: Multiple years of experience in a data-focused role (e.g., Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer).

  • Data Transformation Tooling: Hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool) or similar data transformation frameworks is essential.

  • Data Warehousing: Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

  • Data modelling: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT principles, and dimensional modelling techniques.

  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git for collaborative development and version control.

  • Familiarity with reporting/ BI tools like Looker.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Python expertise for automation, integration, and orchestration

  • Experience with Semantic layers

  • Experience with orchestration tools like Airflow.

  • Knowledge of modern software engineering practices applied to data (e.g., modularity, code review, testing).

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, ensuring customers achieve transformative outcomes. You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales.

The Applied AI for Critical and Sovereign Institutions team is Mistral's specialized unit dedicated to delivering high-impact, secure AI solutions for institutions operating in highly regulated and strategic environments, including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped deployments. In this role, you will drive adoption inside sovereign institutions and critical infrastructure across the UK, partnering with senior leaders and mission owners under real operational, security, and compliance constraints to deliver projects with significant societal, operational, and strategic impact.

 

What you will do

 

Strategic discovery & vision setting

  • Lead executive-level and mission-owner workshops to identify challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in strategic environments.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" and a clear path to value within their regulatory and security perimeter.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify impact, and align solutions with mission and organizational objectives.

AI solution design & deployment

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral's models and platform into customer workflows and secure technical infrastructure (cloud, on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped).

  • Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability, security, and impact.

  • Own the execution of pilots and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value realization & customer success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

  • Monitor key performance indicators tied to operational and business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities across use cases and units, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Demo

At LemFi, we're building the go-to financial app for the Global South.   • You'll help define the scientific and technical standard for credit decisioning at LemFi bringing rigour to experimentation, model development, monitoring, and the translation of insight into production systems.

  • This is a high-leverage role with real business consequence: your recommendations will inform decisions made by senior leadership on risk appetite, market expansion, and the long-term trajectory of LemFi's credit products.

What you'll be doing from day one

  • Owning the end-to-end data science strategy for Credit identifying the highest-value opportunities across underwriting, pricing, line assignment, fraud/risk interaction, collections optimisation, and lifecycle decisioning.

  • Designing, training, validating, and iterating on predictive models that improve credit outcomes, using a strong mix of statistical thinking, machine learning, and practical judgement in a regulated environment.

  • Working closely with Data Engineering and software engineers to productionise models cleanly ensuring features, decision logic, and monitoring are reliable, version-controlled, and scalable.

  • Partnering with Product Managers and Credit leaders to translate ambiguous business problems into measurable hypotheses, model frameworks, experiments, and decision proposals.

  • Building robust monitoring frameworks for model performance, drift, fairness, and operational impact with a high bar for explainability and governance.

  • Leading deep-dive analyses into portfolio behaviour, repayment patterns, loss drivers, and customer segments to uncover actionable opportunities beyond surface-level metrics.

  • Acting as a technical mentor and thought partner to analysts, data scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders raising the bar on problem framing, methodology, and decision quality.

Who you are

  • A senior data scientist who combines strong technical depth with commercial judgement you care about shipping better credit decisions, not just building elegant models.

  • Comfortable operating at staff level: you can set direction in ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and improve systems through judgment rather than waiting for perfectly defined scope.

  • Scientifically rigorous but pragmatic, you know when a simpler model is the right answer, when experimentation is essential, and when operational constraints matter more than theoretical lift.

  • Highly credible with both technical and non-technical audiences able to debate methodology with data practitioners and then explain trade-offs clearly to executives.

  • Motivated by high-stakes, real-world decisioning where accuracy, fairness, and reliability matter because the product affects people's financial lives.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience in data science, machine learning, or quantitative decisioning roles, with meaningful time spent in consumer credit, lending, fintech, or another closely related risk-heavy environment.

  • Strong hands-on fluency in Python and SQL for model development, analysis, feature work, and investigative problem-solving.

  • Deep experience building and evaluating predictive models in production, including feature engineering, validation design, calibration, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • A strong grounding in credit risk concepts and portfolio metrics, including probability of default, loss behaviour, segmentation, and the practical use of bureau or alternative data.

  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to deploy decisioning or ML systems into live products, rather than operating purely in offline research environments.

  • A track record of turning analytical work into measurable commercial or risk outcomes for example improving approval quality, reducing losses, increasing conversion responsibly, or sharpening collections strategy.

  • Strong judgment in regulated or high-accountability settings, where explainability, controls, and decision quality are as important as raw model performance.


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as a first point of contact for Career Services, helping students and recent graduates understand the services, resources and support available to them.

  • A proactive mindset, you are comfortable taking ownership of assigned tasks, asking questions when needed and following through to completion.

  • Reliable, punctual and accountable, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

    • Flexible working hours with a total of 20 hours per week

This role provides practical experience in Career Services, student engagement, event coordination, project and task management, professional communication and stakeholder collaboration within an international higher-education environment.

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities

Senior Finance Coordinator & PMO Manager 
(Finance Office Manager) 

About the role 
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and commercially minded Senior Finance Coordinator & PMO Manager to support and coordinate a broad Finance function of more than 50 colleagues across Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, Credit Control and related areas. 
This is not a pure administrative role. You will act as the operational backbone of the Finance organisation: ensuring that priorities are clear, deadlines are tracked, meetings result in action, cross-functional projects move forward and the CFO office runs effectively. 
You will work closely with the CFO and senior Finance leaders, combining project management, stakeholder coordination, governance support and hands-on operational follow-up.


Key responsibilities

Finance leadership coordination

  • Support the CFO and Finance leadership team in organising priorities, meetings, decision-making and follow-up.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, agendas, briefing materials and action trackers.
  • Ensure decisions, open points, deadlines and ownership are clearly documented and followed through.
  • Coordinate communication across Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, Credit Control and other Finance teams.
  • Act as a central point of contact for internal stakeholders on Finance-related coordination topics.

Project and transformation management

  • CoordinateFinanceprojects,includingprocessimprovements,systemsimplementations,reportingenhancements, organisationalchangesandtransformationinitiatives.
  • Maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, decision logs and status reporting.
  • Challenge delays or unclear ownership constructively and escalate where appropriate.
  • Support project teams in structuring workstreams, preparing workshops and ensuring delivery against agreed milestones.
  • Help turn broad strategic initiatives into clear workplans and practical next steps.

Governance, planning and reporting support

  • Coordinate key Finance calendar activities, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, audit preparation and year-end processes.
  • Support the preparation and coordination of management presentations, board materials and internal reporting packs.
  • Maintain a clear overview of recurring deadlines, governance requirements and deliverables across the Finance function.
  • Support documentation of Finance processes, policies, responsibilities and decision rights.
  • Assist with the preparation of presentations, summaries and high-quality communication for senior stakeholders.

Operational effectiveness

  • Identify recurring inefficiencies, unclear interfaces or bottlenecks across the Finance organisation.
  • Propose and implement practical improvements to ways of working, communication flows, meeting structures and reporting routines.
  • Establish simple, reliable tools for tracking priorities, projects and commitments.
  • Help create a structured, collaborative and accountable Finance culture.
  • Support onboarding, team events and internal communications where relevant to the Finance organisation.


Your profile

  • Several years of experience in a Finance PMO, Finance Business Management, Chief of Staff, consulting, audit, controlling or comparable coordination role.
  • Strong understanding of Finance functions and core processes, ideally including accounting, forecasting, budgeting, audit or reporting cycles.
  • Proven experience managing complex cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with a strong ability to create structure in fast-moving or ambiguous environments.
  • Confident working with senior leaders and able to communicate clearly, diplomatically and assertively.
  • Highly reliable, discreet and comfortable handling sensitive information.
  • Strong PowerPoint, Excel and Microsoft 365 skills; experience with project-management or collaboration tools is an advantage.
  • Fluent English required; German is highly desirable.

What success looks like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Created a transparent Finance leadership and project calendar.
  • Established clear action tracking and follow-up routines across the Finance leadership team.
  • Improved visibility over key Finance projects, risks, dependencies and deadlines.
  • Reduced unnecessary coordination burden on Finance leaders and the CFO.
  • Helped improve collaboration and execution across the wider Finance organisation.
  • Become a trusted point of contact for turning plans and decisions into delivered outcomes.

Personal qualities

You are structured without being rigid, diplomatic without avoiding difficult conversations, and hands-on without losing the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing order to complexity, working with different personalities and ensuring that important work does not get lost between teams.


Why us?

BSBI’s mission is to educate students to effectively shape the future and become excellent leaders of tomorrow in an ever-changing business world. It also aims to teach students to understand how businesses function and how economic success is generated. BSBI offers industry-relevant programs that focus on the development of practical entrepreneurial skills necessary for professional success. Located in the heart of Berlin, we are an international business school that offers academic excellence. We are a member of Global University Systems (GUS) and provide unlimited career opportunities for its students and staff.

jobs.title: Technology Partnerships
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for a commercially sharp, tenacious operator who is exceptional at building relationships to further accelerate our Technology Partnerships motion. This role is based in London.

You'll build, operationalise and deepen our critical external relationships and help turn technology partnerships into a repeatable, scalable source of revenue. We've seen early success with partner-led growth — and are now scaling this into a core growth engine.

What You Can Expect

This role is highly execution-oriented, with direct ownership over Omnea's technology partnerships motion:

  • You'll build new technology partner relationships — defining your priorities based on customer & prospect needs, finding creative ways in, and articulating the mutual benefits

  • You'll operationalise our existing technology partnerships — managing the relationship day-to-day, developing joint go-to-market motions with partners serving the same businesses, and ensuring partners see consistent value from working with Omnea

  • You'll organise community building events for the technology ecosystem

  • You'll be accountable for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, helping unlock new opportunities and improve win rates across deals

  • You'll work hands-on with the Sales team on live deals and work with partners to build unfair advantages to drive joint wins, then codifying what works into repeatable playbooks

  • You'll build trusted relationships with technology partners — keeping their sales teams in lockstep with ours and equipped to confidently recommend Omnea to their clients

  • You'll build that same trust internally — giving our Sales and Customer Success teams the understanding and the incentive to recommend our technology partners to their customers and prospects, so the value flows both ways

About you

  • You have 4–6+ years of experience in fast-moving, high-performance environments

  • You have commercial experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up in a quota-carrier, account management or partnerships role

  • You've got a track record of exceptional performance, whether it's in academia, work, sport, or whatever else you've put your mind to

  • You're deeply commercial and outcome-oriented, able to move between relationship management and execution to drive measurable impact

  • You have the communication skills and polish to work confidently with a variety of stakeholders internally and across technology partners

  • You're intellectually sharp and able to quickly understand complex products, simplifying problems into clear next steps, deal strategy, or product feedback

  • You're ambitious and competitive, thrive on responsibility, and are motivated by building something meaningful in a high-ownership environment

  • You perform best in environments that demand speed, accountability, and autonomy, and you care deeply about building something that lasts

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Praktikum Digital Analytics (m/w/d)| Ab September, München
jobs.description:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht.

  • AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht.
  • SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt.
  • Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.
  • Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht.
  • Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt.
  • Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
  • Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. Das ist für uns keine Formalie: Wer den Projektalltag schon einmal von innen gesehen hat, steigt hier deutlich schneller ein.
  • Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung.
  • Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools.
  • Excel oder Sheets solide, und keine Angst vor größeren Datenmengen. Erste Berührung mit SQL, GA4 oder Search Console ist ein Plus.
  • Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Mindestens 6 Monate. Kürzer lohnt sich für dich nicht – die ersten Wochen gehen fürs Reinkommen drauf.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Ein Praktikum ist bei uns kein Parkplatz. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das noch niemand fertig gelöst hat – mit echten Kundendaten, in einem Team, das dich fragt, was du gesehen hast.

  • Ein Thema mit Zukunft: AI Search ist keine Nische, die wieder verschwindet. Was du hier lernst, ist in zwei Jahren ein gesuchtes Profil und du kannst dann belegen, dass du von Anfang an dabei warst.
  • Echte Betreuung: Feste Ansprechperson, wöchentlicher Jour fixe, Zwischen- und Abschlussfeedback. Kein „Melde dich, wenn du was brauchst“.
  • Übernahmeperspektive, ehrlich benannt: Wir bauen dieses Feld auf und suchen parallel auf Senior-Level. Wenn es passt, ist der Weg über Junior in eine der beiden Rollen realistisch – wir versprechen es nicht, aber wir meinen es.
  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität – Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich, auch als Praktikant:in.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir bekommen Studium und Praktikum zusammen. Prüfungszeiten planen wir ein, wenn du sie früh sagst.
  • Mobility & Events: Öffi-Ticket-Zuschuss, Teamevents und die Chance, auf Fachkonferenzen mitzufahren.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.

Diese Position ist ein Praktikum im Consulting Cluster von TOWA. Die Vergütung beträgt 1.800 EUR brutto pro Monat auf Vollzeitbasis. Bei einem Teilzeit-Modell wird der Betrag aliquot angepasst.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).
